effect_cn: 每当你需要使用或打出一张【闪】时，你可以进行一次判定。若判定结果为红色，视为你使用或打出了一张【闪】。
effect_en: Whenever you need to use or play a [Dodge], you may perform a Judgment. If the result is red (Hearts or Diamonds), it is treated as if you used or played a [Dodge].

faq.q_cn: 若判定结果为黑色，我还能从手牌打出【闪】吗？
faq.a_cn: 可以。判定失败不影响你正常打出【闪】。
faq.q_en: If the Judgment result is black, can I still play a [Dodge] from my hand?
faq.a_en: Yes. A failed Judgment does not prevent you from playing a [Dodge] from your hand normally.

faq.q_cn: 具有修改判定能力的武将技能可以影响【八卦阵】的判定吗？
faq.a_cn: 可以。所有具备修改判定技能的武将都可以影响【八卦阵】的判定结果。
faq.q_en: Can judgment-altering general skills affect [Eight Trigrams Formation]'s Judgment?
faq.a_en: Yes. Any skill that modifies Judgment results can affect [Eight Trigrams Formation].

faq.q_cn: 装备了【青釭剑】的攻击者使用【杀】时，【八卦阵】的判定是否还能生效？
faq.a_cn: 不能。【青釭剑】令目标防具无效，因此【八卦阵】在此次【杀】中无法触发判定。
faq.q_en: If the attacker is equipped with [Qing Gang Sword], can [Eight Trigrams Formation]'s Judgment still activate?
faq.a_en: No. [Qing Gang Sword] Nullifies the target's armor, so [Eight Trigrams Formation] cannot trigger its Judgment for that [Kill].

faq.q_cn: 【八卦阵】可以响应【南蛮入侵】或【万箭齐发】吗？
faq.a_cn: 【八卦阵】可以提供响应【万箭齐发】所需的【闪】，但不能提供响应【南蛮入侵】所需的【杀】。
faq.q_en: Can [Eight Trigrams Formation] respond to [Barbarians] or [Raining Arrows]?
faq.a_en: [Eight Trigrams Formation] can provide the [Dodge] required by [Raining Arrows], but it cannot provide the [Kill] required by [Barbarians].

effect_cn: 锁定技，当你受到伤害时，若伤害值大于1，则你将伤害值改为1；当你失去装备区里的【白银狮子】后，你回复1点体力。
effect_en: Locked Skill: When you take damage, if the damage value is greater than 1, the damage is changed to 1. When you lose [Silver Lion Helmet] from your Equipment Zone, you recover 1 HP.

faq.q_cn: 【青釭剑】可以无效【白银狮子】的减伤效果吗？
faq.a_cn: 可以。【青釭剑】令目标防具无效，装备【青釭剑】的攻击者使用【杀】时，【白银狮子】的减伤锁定技在该次【杀】中无效，攻击者可以造成超过1点的伤害。
faq.q_en: Can [Qing Gang Sword] bypass [Silver Lion Helmet]'s damage reduction?
faq.a_en: Yes. [Qing Gang Sword] Nullifies the target's armor. When an attacker equipped with [Qing Gang Sword] uses [Kill], [Silver Lion Helmet]'s damage reduction is Nullified for that attack, allowing damage exceeding 1 to be dealt.

faq.q_cn: 使用【酒】强化的【杀】造成2点伤害时，【白银狮子】能将伤害减为1吗？
faq.a_cn: 可以。只要最终伤害值大于1，【白银狮子】将其改为1，无论伤害来源如何。
faq.q_en: If a [Wine]-boosted [Kill] would deal 2 damage, does [Silver Lion Helmet] reduce it to 1?
faq.a_en: Yes. As long as the final damage value exceeds 1, [Silver Lion Helmet] reduces it to 1 regardless of the source.

faq.q_cn: 将新防具装入装备区替换【白银狮子】时，是否触发回复体力的效果？
faq.a_cn: 是的。【白银狮子】因被替换而离开装备区，触发回复1点体力的效果。
faq.q_en: If [Silver Lion Helmet] is replaced by equipping a new armor, does the HP recovery trigger?
faq.a_en: Yes. When [Silver Lion Helmet] is replaced by a new armor, you lose it from your Equipment Zone, which triggers the 1 HP recovery.

faq.q_cn: 【白银狮子】对武将技能造成的伤害也有效吗？
faq.a_cn: 有效。【白银狮子】对所有来源的伤害生效，只要伤害值大于1均减为1，不限于【杀】造成的伤害。
faq.q_en: Does [Silver Lion Helmet] apply to damage from general skills (not from [Kill])?
faq.a_en: Yes. [Silver Lion Helmet] applies to all sources of damage. Any damage exceeding 1, regardless of source, is reduced to 1.

effect_cn: 锁定技，当你成为【火攻】或火【杀】的目标时，取消之；若你是小势力角色，你不会被横置。
effect_en: Locked Skill: When you become the target of [Incendiary] or a fire [Kill], you are Removed as the target. If you are a minor-faction character, your General Card cannot be placed into the Chained state.

faq.q_cn: 【朱雀羽扇】将普通【杀】转化为火【杀】后，【明光铠】能取消此目标吗？
faq.a_cn: 可以。只要【杀】的属性在结算时为火属性，【明光铠】均可取消目标。
faq.q_en: If [Vermilion Bird Fan] converts a normal [Kill] into a fire [Kill], can [Radiant Plate] remove you as a target?
faq.a_en: Yes. As long as the [Kill] has the fire property at the time of resolution, [Radiant Plate] can remove you as a target.

faq.q_cn: 装备【青釭剑】的攻击者使用火【杀】时，【明光铠】还能生效吗？
faq.a_cn: 可以。【明光铠】的取消效果发生在成为目标时，早于【青釭剑】令防具无效的结算时机，因此【明光铠】仍然有效。
faq.q_en: If the attacker is equipped with [Qing Gang Sword] and uses a fire [Kill], can [Radiant Plate] still activate?
faq.a_en: Yes. [Radiant Plate]'s target removal occurs at the moment of becoming a target, which is earlier in the resolution order than [Qing Gang Sword]'s armor-negation effect. Therefore [Radiant Plate] still applies.

faq.q_cn: 【明光铠】能防止武将技能造成的火焰伤害吗？
faq.a_cn: 不能。【明光铠】只取消特定卡牌（【火攻】、火【杀】）的目标，不防止武将技能直接造成的火焰伤害。
faq.q_en: Does [Radiant Plate] protect against Fire damage dealt directly by general skills?
faq.a_en: No. [Radiant Plate] only removes you as a target of [Incendiary] and fire [Kill]. It does not prevent Fire damage dealt directly by general skills.

faq.q_cn: 小势力角色的「不被横置」效果在任何时候都生效吗？
faq.a_cn: 是的。只要装备了【明光铠】且为小势力角色，一切令其横置的效果均无效。
faq.q_en: Does the 'cannot be placed into the Chained state' effect for minor-faction characters apply at all times while equipped?
faq.a_en: Yes. As long as [Radiant Plate] is equipped and the character is a minor-faction character, all effects that would place their General Card into the Chained state are Nullified.

effect_cn: 锁定技，黑色的【杀】对你无效。
effect_en: Locked Skill: Black [Kill] cards are Nullified against you.

faq.q_cn: 【仁王盾】对黑色的雷【杀】是否有效？
faq.a_cn: 有效。只要【杀】的花色为黑色（黑桃或梅花），无论其属性（普通、雷、火），【仁王盾】均令其无效。
faq.q_en: Does [Vajra Shield] Nullify a black thunder [Kill]?
faq.a_en: Yes. As long as the [Kill] card is black (Spades or Clubs), it is Nullified regardless of its elemental type (normal, thunder, or fire).

faq.q_cn: 【青釭剑】能令【仁王盾】无效吗？
faq.a_cn: 可以。【青釭剑】令目标防具无效，因此装备【青釭剑】的攻击者使用黑色【杀】时，【仁王盾】在该次攻击中无效。
faq.q_en: Can [Qing Gang Sword] Nullify [Vajra Shield]?
faq.a_en: Yes. [Qing Gang Sword] Nullifies the target's armor, so a black [Kill] will land normally when the attacker is equipped with [Qing Gang Sword].

faq.q_cn: 【仁王盾】对红色的【杀】是否有任何效果？
faq.a_cn: 没有。【仁王盾】只对黑色【杀】生效，红色【杀】正常结算。
faq.q_en: Does [Vajra Shield] have any effect on red [Kill] cards?
faq.a_en: No. [Vajra Shield] only affects black [Kill] cards. Red [Kill] cards resolve normally.

effect_cn: 锁定技，【南蛮入侵】、【万箭齐发】和普通【杀】对你无效；当你受到火焰伤害时，此伤害+1。
effect_en: Locked Skill: [Barbarians], [Raining Arrows], and normal [Kill] cards are Nullified against you. When you take Fire damage, increase that damage by 1.

faq.q_cn: 【藤甲】对雷【杀】和火【杀】是否有效？
faq.a_cn: 无效。【藤甲】只令普通【杀】无效，雷【杀】和火【杀】可以正常命中。此外，受到火焰伤害时伤害还会+1。
faq.q_en: Does [Rattan Armour] protect against thunder [Kill] or fire [Kill]?
faq.a_en: No. [Rattan Armour] only Nullifies normal (non-elemental) [Kill]. Thunder [Kill] and fire [Kill] land normally, and Fire damage additionally increases by 1.

faq.q_cn: 【青釭剑】可以无效【藤甲】吗？
faq.a_cn: 可以。装备【青釭剑】的攻击者使用普通【杀】时，【藤甲】在该次攻击中无效，普通【杀】正常命中。
faq.q_en: Can [Qing Gang Sword] Nullify [Rattan Armour]?
faq.a_en: Yes. When an attacker equipped with [Qing Gang Sword] uses a normal [Kill], [Rattan Armour] is Nullified for that attack and the [Kill] lands normally.

faq.q_cn: 【藤甲】的火焰伤害+1是否叠加在原有伤害之上？
faq.a_cn: 是的。例如，受到1点火焰伤害时实际受到2点伤害；受到2点火焰伤害时实际受到3点伤害。
faq.q_en: Is the Fire damage +1 from [Rattan Armour] added on top of the original damage?
faq.a_en: Yes. For example, 1 point of Fire damage becomes 2; 2 points of Fire damage becomes 3.

faq.q_cn: 铁索连环传导的火焰伤害是否也会触发【藤甲】的+1效果？
faq.a_cn: 是的。连环传导的伤害若为火焰属性，装备【藤甲】的角色受到的伤害+1。
faq.q_en: Does Fire damage transmitted via [Iron Shackles] chain also trigger [Rattan Armour]'s +1 penalty?
faq.a_en: Yes. If chain-transmitted damage has the fire property, a character equipped with [Rattan Armour] takes +1 damage from it.

effect_cn: 此牌不能被无视，该技能不能被无效：1.你可以将一张手牌当【闪】使用；2.当你受到【杀】造成的伤害时，你弃置装备区里的【烂银甲】。
effect_en: This card cannot be ignored and its effects cannot be Nullified: 1. You may use a hand card as a [Dodge]; 2. When you take damage from a [Kill], discard [Tarnished Silver Armor] from your Equipment Zone.

effect_cn: 锁定技，体力为一点时，任何伤害对你无效。当你失去装备区里的【百花裙】时，你可以摸两张牌。
effect_en: Locked Skill: When your HP Value is 1, all damage is Nullified against you. When you lose [Hundred Flowers Skirt] from your Equipment Zone, you may draw 2 cards.

effect_cn: 锁定技，你每次受到大于等于2点伤害时，该伤害-1。
锁定技，武将牌不能被翻面。
effect_en: Locked Skill: Whenever you take damage of 2 or more, that damage is reduced by 1.
Locked Skill: Your General Card cannot be flipped.

effect_cn: 锁定技，属性伤害对你无效。
effect_en: Locked Skill: Elemental damage is Nullified against you.

effect_cn: 锁定技，红色的【杀】对你无效，你的手牌上限+2。
effect_en: Locked Skill: Red [Kill] cards are Nullified against you. Your Hand Limit is increased by 2.

effect_cn: 当有你成为【杀】的目标时，可丢弃1张手牌，转移给与你距离为1的角色。
effect_en: When you become the target of a [Kill], you may discard 1 hand card to redirect that [Kill] to a character at Distance 1 from you.

faq.q_cn: 【天龙炎盾】可以将【杀】转移给谁？
faq.a_cn: 你弃置一张手牌后，可以将此【杀】对你的目标转移给与你距离为1的另一名合法角色。不能转移给此【杀】的使用者或已经是此【杀】目标的角色。距离从你计算，并计入适用的距离修正；新目标不必在使用者的攻击范围内。
faq.q_en: Who can receive a [Kill] redirected by [Celestial Dragon Flame Shield]?
faq.a_en: After discarding 1 hand card, you may redirect the [Kill] from yourself to another legal target at Distance 1 from you. You cannot choose the [Kill]'s user or a character already targeted by that [Kill]. Measure Distance from you, including applicable modifiers; the new target need not be within the user's Attack Range.

faq.q_cn: 转移多目标【杀】时，其他目标也会改变吗？
faq.a_cn: 不会。新目标只替代你，你不再结算被转移的这一次目标效果；此【杀】的其他目标不变。
faq.q_en: Does redirecting a multi-target [Kill] change its other targets?
faq.a_en: No. The new target replaces only you, and you no longer resolve the redirected target occurrence. All other targets of that [Kill] remain unchanged.

effect_cn: 黑色的锦囊牌对你无效。
effect_en: Black Tool cards are Nullified against you.

effect_cn: 每当你受到伤害时，可选择攻击范围内的一名角色给你1张手牌，否则该角色减少1点体力。
effect_en: Whenever you take damage, you may choose a character within your Attack Range. That character must give you 1 hand card, or they lose 1 HP.

effect_cn: 血量上限+1；主公无法装备，但可打出此牌，恢复1点血(不能进行濒死恢复)。
effect_en: Your Max HP increases by 1. The Lord cannot equip this card, but may Play it to recover 1 HP (cannot be played during the Verge of Death State).

faq.q_cn: 主公如何打出【玄武護臂】？装备此牌会回复体力吗？
faq.a_cn: 主公不能装备【玄武護臂】，但可于自己的出牌阶段内，在已受伤时打出此牌并回复1点体力，然后将此牌置入弃牌堆；不能在濒死状态中以此法打出。其他角色装备此牌时，体力上限增加1点，但不会因此回复体力。
faq.q_en: How does the Lord play [Black Tortoise Bracer], and does equipping it recover HP?
faq.a_en: The Lord cannot equip [Black Tortoise Bracer], but may play it during their own Play Phase while Wounded to recover 1 HP, then place it into the Discard Pile. It cannot be played during the Verge of Death State. When another character equips it, their Max HP increases by 1, but they do not recover HP.

effect_cn: 锁定技，防止你受到的所有伤害，当你失去装备区的【混沌甲】时，你失去X点体力，X为【混沌甲】防止过的伤害次数。
effect_en: Locked Skill: Prevent all damage you take. When you lose [Primal Chaos Plate] from your Equipment Zone, you lose X HP, where X equals the number of times damage was prevented by this card.

faq.q_cn: 【混沌甲】如何累计离开装备区时要失去的体力？
faq.a_cn: 每防止一次伤害，离开装备区时要失去的体力就增加1点，与该次伤害的点数无关。防止伤害时不会增加或扣减你的体力。例如，先后防止一次3点伤害和一次1点伤害，累计的是2点体力流失；此牌离开你的装备区时，你一次失去2点体力，而不是4点。这是体力流失，不是伤害。
faq.q_en: How does [Primal Chaos Plate] accumulate its HP-loss cost?
faq.a_en: Each time this armor prevents a damage event, add 1 to the HP you must lose when it leaves your Equipment Zone, regardless of the damage amount prevented. Preventing damage does not increase or reduce your HP. For example, preventing one 3-damage event and one 1-damage event means you lose 2 HP at once when the armor leaves, not 4. This is HP loss, not damage.

faq.q_cn: 【混沌甲】的累计数何时清零？
faq.a_cn: 推荐房规：只记录此牌本次连续留在当前装备者装备区期间防止伤害的次数。此牌离开时，原装备者按累计数失去体力，然后清零。再次装备或转移给另一名角色时，从零重新累计。
faq.q_en: When does [Primal Chaos Plate]'s count reset?
faq.a_en: Recommended house rule: count only damage events prevented during this card's current continuous stay in its wearer's Equipment Zone. When it leaves, that wearer loses HP equal to the count, then the count resets. Re-equipping it or moving it to another wearer starts a new count at zero.

effect_cn: 锁定技，每当你使用或打出【闪】后，对方受到你造成的1点伤害。
effect_en: Locked Skill: After each time you use or play a [Dodge], the attacker takes 1 damage dealt by you.

faq.q_cn: 【刃盾】所指的“对方”是谁？视为使用或打出的【闪】会触发吗？
faq.a_cn: “对方”指令你需要使用或打出【闪】的牌或有来源效果的使用者。例如，响应【杀】或【万箭齐发】时，对方分别为【杀】或【万箭齐发】的使用者；若该要求没有存活的角色来源，则不造成伤害。因其他效果视为使用或打出的【闪】也会触发【刃盾】。
faq.q_en: Who is 'the other side' for [Blade Shield], and does a virtual [Dodge] trigger it?
faq.a_en: It is the character who used the card or sourced effect that required the [Dodge]. For example, when responding to [Kill] or [Raining Arrows], it is that card's user. If the requirement has no living character source, no damage is dealt. A [Dodge] treated as used or played by another effect also triggers [Blade Shield].

effect_cn: 锁定技，每当一名角色摸牌时，若此次摸牌数多于1，则将摸牌数改为1。
一名角色的准备阶段开始时，所有角色可以选择是否弃置一张牌，然后令此牌对其无效。
effect_en: Locked Skill: Whenever a character draws cards, if they would draw more than 1, the number of cards drawn is reduced to 1.
At the start of a character's Preparation Phase, each character may choose to discard 1 card to have [Ancient Paperweight]'s effect Nullified against them.

faq.q_cn: 弃牌后，【古铜镇尺】对谁无效，持续多久？
faq.a_cn: 推荐房规：在一名角色的准备阶段开始时，选择弃置一张牌的角色不受【古铜镇尺】的摸牌限制，直到当前回合结束。每名角色分别选择，弃牌只使自己获得此次豁免。
faq.q_en: Who is exempt from [Ancient Paperweight] after discarding, and for how long?
faq.a_en: Recommended house rule: at the start of a character's Preparation Phase, each character who chooses to discard 1 card is exempt from [Ancient Paperweight]'s draw restriction until the current turn ends. Each character chooses separately; discarding exempts only that character.

faq.q_cn: 【古铜镇尺】会把多次摸牌合并为只摸一张吗？
faq.a_cn: 不会。它分别检查每次摸牌事件，未获得豁免的角色一次摸多于一张牌时才改为一张。例如，两次各摸一张仍共摸两张；一次摸两张则改为一张。
faq.q_en: Does [Ancient Paperweight] combine separate draws into a single card?
faq.a_en: No. It checks each draw event separately. Unless exempt, a character drawing more than 1 card in one event draws 1 instead. Two separate draws of 1 card still give 2 cards in total; one draw of 2 cards gives only 1.

effect_cn: 锁定技，当你成为【杀】的目标后，若你是男性角色，你进行判定，若结果为黑色，此【杀】伤害+1。
effect_en: Locked Skill: After you become the target of a [Kill], if you are male, perform a Judgment. If the result is black, that [Kill] deals +1 damage.

effect_cn: 当你需要使用或打出【闪】时，你可以进行一次判定，若结果为红色，视为你使用或打出之。判定前，你可以令一名死亡角色「卜算3」。
effect_en: When you need to use or play a [Dodge], you may perform a Judgment. If the result is red, it is treated as you using or playing a [Dodge]. Before the Judgment, you may have one dead character perform 「Foresight 3」.

faq.q_cn: 什么是「卜算X」？
faq.a_cn: 「卜算X」指观看牌堆顶的X张牌，然后将这些牌以任意顺序置于牌堆顶或牌堆底。
faq.q_en: What is 「Foresight X」?
faq.a_en: 「Foresight X」 means looking at the top X cards of the Draw Pile, then placing them on the top or bottom of the Draw Pile in any order.

faq.q_cn: 【魂·八卦阵】的判定流程中，可以操作提供此技能的装备牌吗？
faq.a_cn: 不能。在因【魂·八卦阵】进行的判定流程中，不能以任何方式操作装备区里提供此技能的装备牌；但在此【闪】的使用流程中仍可操作该装备牌。
faq.q_en: During the Judgment process of [Soul · Eight Trigrams Formation], can the equipment card providing this skill be manipulated?
faq.a_en: No. During the Judgment process caused by [Soul · Eight Trigrams Formation], the equipment card providing this skill cannot be manipulated in any way. However, during the [Dodge] use process itself, that equipment card may still be manipulated.
